payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcome.target: A recognizable frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl, within the bowl opening rather than on the lid, tank, rim, or floor.
outcome.reference: The toilet bowl in the input image.

check.question: Is a recognizable frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
check.complete_when: At least one recognizable frog is visibly within the toilet bowl opening, inside the rim; it is not merely on the raised lid, tank, rim, or floor.
check.partial_when: A frog has been added to the toilet area but is only on the lid, tank, or rim, or is otherwise not clearly inside the bowl; no frog is clearly inside the bowl.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to or placed at the toilet.
check.unknown_when: The toilet bowl or relevant area cannot be assessed, or the evidence is ambiguous about whether a frog is inside the bowl.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A recognizable green frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl opening, within the rim. Other frogs appear on the lid, tank area, and floor, but the bowl frog fulfills the requested placement."}

parsed.evidence: A recognizable green frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl opening, within the rim. Other frogs appear on the lid, tank area, and floor, but the bowl frog fulfills the requested placement.
